modules.responsibility: Handle data import from JSON files or textarea input.
Detect highlights based on scoring logic and generate a list of detected moments.
Provide filtering and sorting functionality for detected highlights.
Allow users to manually add highlights to the dataset and manage form interactions.
Export filtered highlights as a downloadable file.
Persist working data locally and reload it on page load.
Render UI components and handle user interactions.
Integrate all modules and provide the main application logic.

test_strategy: Unit tests for each module to ensure individual functionality.
Integration tests to verify modules work together correctly.
UI tests to ensure user interactions are functional and intuitive.
Performance tests to validate scoring and sorting efficiency with large datasets.
Acceptance tests to confirm all criteria are met.
acceptance_criteria: Generated project must run locally from index.html under python -m http.server.
Provide a real JSON import path using FileReader and/or a textarea; imported data must be processed by the app.
Implement a real scoring function and sort detected items by score descending in executable JavaScript.
Provide visible filter controls and executable filter logic for the requested fields.
Provide a manual marker form/control that appends a new item to the working dataset and rerenders results.
Provide a real export action using Blob, URL.createObjectURL, an anchor download, and the current filtered result set.
Persist working data locally with localStorage and reload it on page load.
Use domain fields such as streamer, game, timestamp/time, category, intensity, chatRate, keywords, title, description, and score.
